findings.assessment: Review the actual workload service account; raw SCC-defaulted/Pod-admitted specs are validated before decoding and required-SCC authorization is explicit. Admission is authoritative on the target.

Read synchronized policy/v1 disruption budgets before retirement; no eviction requests or unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy changes are emitted. Controller scaling is checked explicitly because eviction protection alone would not prevent it.

Preserve baseline probe/security settings and validate admitted Pods. Kubelet/runtime/kernel behavior and application startup remain runtime prerequisites; HTTP health checks do not certify every container probe or kernel.

Use autoscaling/v2, preserve names/metrics/full HPA spec, retarget only the reference, and validate raw responses. Metrics availability is an operator/controller prerequisite, not proved by retargeting.

Production treats credentials as opaque and does not fetch automatically generated Secret names. Harness obtains explicit short-lived tokens. Expiry/denials remain visible failures with recovery state.

Upstream fix was backported for1.27.2 (PR117825); official OpenShift4.14.0 uses1.27.6. This does not require a new guard for the supported floor. Exact primary-patch and payload evidence is recorded by the4.15/4.16 reviewer.

Preserve envFrom/Secret references, do not bypass target ServiceAccount admission, and keep real Pod dry-run errors authoritative. Cluster security patches remain administrator prerequisites. Production does not add ephemeral containers.

CephFS/RBD/gitRepo portability already has manual guards. Newly identified independent PV zone/region labels require manual scheduling review; node affinity alone cannot establish usable capacity. CSI topology/driver attachment/mount/SELinux support remains a runtime prerequisite.
Discover optional ANP/BANP resources and assess changed source/destination selection; future pod-template-hash selection requires manual review. This is not a full traffic or CNI simulation.
